name: Fleeting JKT
source:
Kaimana, Jericho, and the rest of the crew of the Battleship Nimue get lost in space. And, well, space can be boring... So why not play a fun game of rock-paper-scissors with everyone's favorite little twist?

[From [url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/fleetingjkt]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Kaimana、Jericho以及战列舰Nimue上的其他船员在太空中迷了路。太空生活嘛，难免无聊……何不来一场剪刀石头布，再加上大家最喜欢的那点“小花样”？

[摘自[url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/fleetingjkt]Itch.io[/url]]
